data.title: Is Alibaba (BABA) Quietly Reframing Its AI Story Through Tourism Robots And Sports Fan Tech?
data.description: Amap, Alibaba Group’s location-based services platform, and Sands China recently delivered the first batch of “Tutu” robot dogs to serve as robotic guides at Sands Resorts Macau, while Alibaba also entered a multi-year technology and cloud partnership with the Brooklyn Nets to power real-time 360° replays and personalized fan collectibles. These collaborations highlight how Alibaba is applying its AI, spatial intelligence, and cloud capabilities in real-world tourism and sports settings,...
